successCriteria.description: The `policy -> leave-type` edge is confirmed present in the committed dependency maps — `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` (feature 7dc62161 dependency map and feature e8c586bc dependency map both list `policy -> leave-type`) and `.gestalt/architecture/reconciled.json` (contains `{"from_":"policy","to":"leave-type"}`) — so the finding is a false positive and no code change is required to resolve it.

`src/modules/policy/policy.service.ts:3` continues to import `ILeaveTypeService`, `LeaveTypeService`, and `PgLeaveTypeRepository` from `../leave-type` (the leave-type module's public entry point `src/modules/leave-type/index.ts`), and all three symbols remain exported from that entry point and used in the file — no import is removed, re-routed, or inlined as a result of this phase.
`npm run build` remains clean and the existing unit suite passes unchanged, proving the resolution introduced no behavioral or type regression in the policy module.

constraints: No production source file may be modified to resolve this finding — the `policy -> leave-type` dependency is already sanctioned by the committed architecture, so the resolution is a no-op on code. Any change to `src/modules/policy/policy.service.ts` (or any other module) would be out of scope and would risk introducing a regression.

The `policy -> leave-type` dependency must continue to be expressed through the leave-type module's public entry point (`src/modules/leave-type/index.ts`), never by reaching into leave-type internals (e.g. `../leave-type/leave-type.service` or `../leave-type/leave-type.repository`).

The `PolicyService` class, its constructor signature, and its runtime behavior must remain unchanged — the phase must not alter how `PolicyService` consumes `ILeaveTypeService` (the `getLeaveTypeByCode` existence check in `createLeavePolicy`).
outOfScope: Any code edit to `src/modules/policy/policy.service.ts` or any other module — the finding is a false positive, so there is nothing to fix in source.

Moving the `LeaveTypeService`/`PgLeaveTypeRepository` construction concern into the shared layer or otherwise relocating the `policy -> leave-type` edge — the committed architecture places this edge in the policy module and it must stay there.
Amending `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` or `.gestalt/architecture/reconciled.json` — both already list `policy -> leave-type` as permitted, so no dependency-map amendment is needed.

entityInvariants.invariant: PolicyService depends on ILeaveTypeService through the leave-type public entry point and uses it to reject `createLeavePolicy` with NotFoundError(404) when `leaveTypeCode` references an unknown leave type; this cross-module dependency is a permanent, sanctioned part of the policy module's contract and must not be removed or relocated.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws NotFoundError(404) when the referenced leaveTypeCode does not exist (via the injected ILeaveTypeService.getLeaveTypeByCode), and ValidationError(400) for invalid input — unchanged by this phase.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The `policy -> leave-type` dependency must match the committed dependency map: `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` feature 7dc62161 lists `policy -> leave-type` (and feature e8c586bc also lists it), and `.gestalt/architecture/reconciled.json` contains the edge `{"from_":"policy","to":"leave-type"}`. The import at `policy.service.ts:3` is consistent with these and must not be changed.

The three imported symbols (`ILeaveTypeService`, `LeaveTypeService`, `PgLeaveTypeRepository`) must remain exported from the leave-type module's public entry point, matching the exports declared in `src/modules/leave-type/index.ts`.

The `PolicyService` constructor must continue to accept `ILeaveTypeService` as an injected dependency and call `getLeaveTypeByCode` to enforce the leave-type existence invariant, matching the behavior documented in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` Phase 2 delivered section.

integrationPoints.why: The policy module's only sanctioned dependency on leave-type; it must continue to export ILeaveTypeService, LeaveTypeService, and PgLeaveTypeRepository for the import at policy.service.ts:3.
